author: Omid Mohajerani
text: Heads up - client_credentials is not enabled any more, you get 'Default Admin User Not Setup'. Use the auth-code flow instead: browser, logged in, hit /oauth/authorize with client_id and redirect_uri, submit, pick the client, submit, then exchange the code at /oauth/token. Headers on calls are Authorization: Bearer <token> plus Key: <client_id>.
